name: ECC
description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
one_liner: A memory and habits upgrade for your AI coding assistant, so it remembers your project and follows good practices instead of starting from zero every session.
buyer: A freelance or indie developer who already pays for Claude Code or Cursor and is frustrated re-explaining their codebase every session.
business_use_cases: A solo developer installs it so their AI coding agent keeps a running memory of project decisions across sessions instead of re-discovering them each time.
A small dev shop standardizes every engineer's coding agent on the same 'instincts' and security checks so juniors don't ship risky code.
A plugin author builds and sells a custom skill pack on top of ECC for a specific stack (e.g. Rails, Unity) and distributes it through the GitHub App marketplace.

money_ideas.idea: Sell private-repo access to the hosted GitHub App (ECC Pro) as the maintainer already does.
Build and sell an industry-specific skill/instinct pack (fintech compliance, healthcare privacy) on top of the open framework.

steal_this: Package a narrow, high-value skill pack (e.g. 'PCI-compliant payments code review') for ECC and sell it directly to teams in that niche this weekend.
